answer.reason: The instance has a "Carousel" component (reference name `carousel`) that is used for slider-style content (e.g., a product screenshot slider). Its model has a single nested Linked Content field, "Slides", which points to the "Carousel Slide" content model (reference name `carouselSlide`). Each slide item carries heading, description, a background image (ideal for a screenshot), and an optional CTA link/text — exactly the shape needed for a new slide. Since Slides is a nested grid field on the Carousel item, new slide content items are created as children of that field using the carouselSlide model/definition.
